title: odd-popover
description: A non-modal surface anchored to the control that opens it. The host is the popover (`popover="auto"`), so `<button popovertarget="id">` opens and closes it with no script; it also closes on Escape, on a press outside, and with its close button, and focus returns to the trigger. With `interest`, it is a hover card: it also opens while the pointer rests on its anchor or the anchor has focus.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

anchor.description: The ID of the element it is placed against, in the same document or shadow root. Default: the button whose `popovertarget` names it; with neither, it is centred.

side.description: The side of the anchor it opens on, in the anchor's writing direction; it flips to the other side when there is more room there.

align.description: How it lines up with the anchor along that side.

no-close.description: Hides the close button. Keep it wherever touch users need it: Safari on iOS before 18.3 does not close a popover on a tap outside.

interest.description: A hover card (HTML interest invokers): it also opens once the pointer has rested on its anchor, or the anchor has had focus, for half a second, and closes a quarter of a second after both have left the anchor and the popover. A touch keeps the anchor's own action.
